img.caption: Fig 8: OOS detection ROC on CLINC150. The retrieval-fused nonconformity score achieves AUROC=0.975, providing a usable signal for the FPR95 OOS gate; LLM self-confidence is trivial (AUROC=1.0) because the model always outputs low confidence on OOS, so it cannot distinguish in-domain hard queries from OOS without retrieval.
